title: Token Hacking ep.7: measured 30-question code-search test -- plain Claude 6.72M tokens, Graphify alone 7.72M (+15%, worse), Graphify + Jev file-ranking 5.45M (-19%)

tools.name: Graphify
tools.detail: Codebase graph tool 'heard was amazing at saving tokens'; out of the box it increased tokens 15%

tools.name: Jev (TypeSafe AI)
tools.detail: Small classifier model used to rank/pick the right file from the graph; '$0.002' per ranking shown on screen

tools.name: Claude (Sonnet agent)
tools.detail: 'one Claude Sonnet agent per question, same repo'

claims: Baseline Claude workflow burned ~6.72M tokens across 30 code questions (27/30 correct)
Adding Graphify out of the box burned 7.72M tokens, +15% vs baseline, and got fewer right (25/30)
Graphify + Jev ranking burned 5.45M tokens, -19% vs baseline, 27/30 correct, ranked for $0.002
Transcript rounds this to 'saving 2 million vs Graphify and 1 million vs out-of-the-box Claude'
Creator hits his weekly usage limit 'a couple days into my reset'
how_to_steps: Record a baseline: run your workflow (30 code questions, one Sonnet agent each) and log tokens processed
Install Graphify on the repo and rerun; compare tokens and correctness
Add Jev as a ranking step so it picks the right file from the graph before Claude reads it; rerun
Optionally have Claude implement Graphify + Jev itself, or use the creator's one-shot prompt from the first comment
on_screen_only: Bar chart card: 'STEP 03 -- TOKENS TO FIND THE CODE / Add Jev ranking / Same graph. Jev picks the right file. Fewest tokens.' Bars: grep only (BASELINE) 6.72M, 27 of 30 correct; Graphify (OUT OF THE BOX) 7.72M, +15% vs baseline, 25 of 30 correct; Graphify + Jev (RANKED FOR $0.002) 5.45M, -19% vs baseline, 27 of 30 correct
Footnote: 'Tokens processed, in millions. 30 code questions, one Claude Sonnet agent per question, same repo, 0 errors. Bars start at zero.'
Top and bottom of the chart card are pixelated/blurred (hidden content)
cta: One-shot prompt is 'the first comment in the description'; daily series

relevance.why: Token burn on weekly limits is Haji's real constraint, and this is one of the few creators publishing before/after numbers. But the series is heavily Jev/TypeSafe-centric (already saturated in the liked set) and the net gain is ~19%, not 'millions'.

implement_score.why: Worth a one-hour experiment only if Haji already has a Jev key: baseline tokens, then Graphify + Jev file ranking. The real takeaway is cheaper: graph/index tools can INCREASE tokens, so measure before adopting any 'token saver'.

verify: What exactly is Graphify (repo/author)? Is it a Claude Code skill, MCP, or CLI, and is it maintained?
Is ducktate sponsored by or affiliated with TypeSafe/Jev (episodes 7 and 10 both push Jev)?
Methodology: 'tokens processed' includes cached input? 30 questions on one repo is a small sample
Jev pricing/availability for a solo founder ($0.002 per ranking claim)

gap.what: New tool name (Graphify) and a measured warning that it raised token use 15% on its own; Jev-as-file-ranker is a new use of an already-liked model. Also a general correction: 'token saver' tools need A/B measurement.
